_notes: This is a Firebase service account credentials file used for Firebase Storage operations in the Fable RPG bot.
_description: This file contains credentials that allow the bot to upload images to Firebase Storage for features like pet generation, background removal, and image processing.
_security_warning: ⚠️ CRITICAL: This file contains sensitive credentials that give full access to your Firebase project. Never commit this file to version control!
_setup_instructions: To set up this file: 1) Go to Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts 2) Generate new private key 3) Download the JSON file 4) Rename to 'acc.json' and place in the Fable directory 5) Add 'acc.json' to .gitignore
_usage: Used by cogs: process_splice, soulforge, patreon for Firebase Storage uploads
_environment_alternative: Consider using environment variables instead: FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_JSON
